strictMode.willDeactivate: Will deactivate automatically when the timer expires.
strictMode.onceActivated: Once activated, strict mode : cannot be cancelled until the timer has expired.
strictMode.tipsDesc: Practical strategies to stop yourself from finding workarounds.
strictMode.tip1Desc: Let a friend or colleague know you've activated Strict Mode. Social accountability beats willpower every time.
strictMode.tip2Desc: Strict Mode blocks sites in Chrome, but not tabs already open. Close everything unrelated to your task before activating.
strictMode.tip3Title: Write down what you will do instead
strictMode.tip3Desc: Before activating, write 3 specific tasks you will work on. An empty agenda is the enemy of focus.
strictMode.tip4Title: Remember: the timer will run out
strictMode.tip4Desc: The discomfort is temporary. The work you do during this time is permanent.
strictMode.tipsBanner: People who set up external accountability are 3× more likely to follow through than those who rely on motivation alone.

pricing.faqQ1: How do I activate my plan after payment?
pricing.faqA1: Log in with the email used at purchase. Your plan will be activated automatically within minutes of payment.
pricing.faqQ2: Can I cancel my monthly or annual subscription?
pricing.faqA2: Yes, you can cancel anytime from your Maketou dashboard. Your Premium access remains active until the end of the paid period.
pricing.faqQ3: Does the Lifetime plan include future updates?
pricing.faqA3: Yes, absolutely. All future updates to Blockweb Master are included forever, with no additional cost.
pricing.faqA4: We offer a full refund within 7 days if you're not satisfied. Contact support with your purchase email.
pricing.faqQ5: Is my plan tied to a single device?
pricing.faqA5: No, your license is linked to your email account. You can use it on all your devices by logging in with the same email.
pricing.faqQ6: What is the difference between the Annual and Lifetime plans?
pricing.faqA6: The Annual plan renews each year at $27. The Lifetime plan is a one-time payment of $45 that gives you access to Blockweb Master forever — paid off in less than 2 years.
pricing.paymentInstructions: Secure payment via MakeTou · Log in with your purchase email to activate your plan.
